summary: feat(payments-next): add passkey sign-in and Accounts-style buttons to checkout
description:
Because
- Accounts redesigned to add passkey sign-in; checkout should offer same options

This commit
- Adds AuthOptionButton to payments-ui, matching the Accounts BoxButton
- Shows Sign in with passkey above Google and Apple on the checkout start page
- Routes passkey through the Accounts login page, as passkeys only work there
- Gates the passkey button behind FEATURE_FLAG_PASSKEY_SIGNIN (off by default)
- Adds start page tests for button order, the flag, and signIn arguments

Closes PAY-3842
